extract: Aisha Wahab is an American politician who has served as the U.S. representative from California's 14th congressional district since 2026. A member of the Democratic Party, Wahab previously served as a member of the California State Senate from the 10th district from 2022 to 2026 and on the Hayward City Council from 2018 to 2022.
